title: The fixed ordinary open-image comparison respects nested restriction
statement: For a scheme morphism h:X→Y, opens W≤U of Y and an O_X-module M, let F=h_* and D be the fixed comparison [lem-pc-open-image-direct-image-comparison-unit]. For the unsigned open-image restriction maps ρ [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data], D_U(M);ρ_{U,W,F(M)}=F(ρ_{h⁻¹U,h⁻¹W,M});D_W(M). There is no covering or injectivity hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 08FE, underived identity in the proof, and 08BV, displayed section sequence; official Stacks pages read online

proof.text:
Reuse the proved private helpers isIso_smaller_restriction_unit and cancel_into_right_adjoint from OpenImageComplexComparisonRestriction by a proof-only import all. The first supplies invertibility of the larger-open unit restricted to the smaller open, and the second supplies cancellation after transposing under the smaller-open adjunction. Open direct image is fully faithful, so the larger-open restriction
of its adjunction unit is invertible. Applying the overlap restriction and
conjugating by schemeOpenRestrictionCompIso shows that restriction of this
unit to the smaller open is invertible as well. Unit compatibility of the
ordinary comparison transfers this property to the direct image of the
inverse-image-open unit. The smaller-open adjunction Hom equivalence therefore
allows cancellation of that direct image in maps into the smaller-open image.
After precomposition by it, both sides become the smaller-open unit: use
schemeOpenModuleImage_unit_restriction on X and Y and the comparison unit
identity at U and W. This proves equality without expanding the nested mate
on sections. Empty and repeated opens need no exception; all the adjunction
identities and invertibilities continue to hold.

proof_origin.note: Reuse existing private invertibility and adjunction-cancellation helpers via import all; combine ordinary unit compatibility with the fixed unit-restriction identity. No duplicate helper is declared.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeOpenImageDirectImageComparison_restriction
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) {W U : Y.Opens} (i : W ⟶ U)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) :
    (schemeOpenImageDirectImageComparison h U).hom.app M ≫
        (schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction Y i).app
          ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj M) =
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).map
          ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X ((Opens.map h.base).map i)).app M) ≫
        (schemeOpenImageDirectImageComparison h W).hom.app M
